source.citation: LaFontaine, J.H., and Riley, J.W., 2023, Model Input and Output for Hydrologic Simulations for the Conterminous United States for Historical and Future Conditions Using the National Hydrologic Model Infrastructure (NHM) and the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project Phase 5 (CMIP5), 1950 - 2100: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9EBKREQ.

dh1.description: Annual maximum daily flow. Compute the maximum of a 1-day moving average flow for each year. DH1 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dh15.description: High flow pulse duration. Compute the average duration for flow events with flows above a threshold equal to the 75th percentile value for each year in the flow record. DH15 is the median of the yearly average durations (days/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dh2.description: Annual maximum of 3-day moving average flows. Compute the maximum of a 3-day moving average flow for each year. DH2 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dh3.description: Annual maximum of 7-day moving average flows. Compute the maximum of a 7-day moving average flow for each year. DH3 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dh4.description: Annual maximum of 30-day moving average flows. Compute the maximum of 30-day moving average flows. Compute the maximum of a 30-day moving average flow for each year. DH4 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dh5.description: Annual maximum of 90-day moving average flows. Compute the maximum of a 90-day moving average flow for each year. DH5 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dl1.description: Annual minimum daily flow. Compute the minimum 1-day average flow for each year. DL1 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dl16.description: Low flow pulse duration. Compute the average pulse duration for each year for flow events below a threshold equal to the 25th percentile value for the entire flow record. DL16 is the median of the yearly average durations (days/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dl2.description: Annual minimum of 3-day moving average flow. Compute the minimum of a 3-day moving average flow for each year. DL2 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dl3.description: Annual minimum of 7-day moving average flow. Compute the minimum of a 7-day moving average flow for each year. DL3 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dl4.description: Annual minimum of 30-day moving average flow. Compute the minimum of a 30-day moving average flow for each year. DL4 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

dl5.description: Annual minimum of 90-day moving average flow. Compute the minimum of a 90-day moving average flow for each year. DL5 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

fh1.description: High flood pulse count. Compute the average number of flow events with flows above a threshold equal to the 75th percentile value for the entire flow record. FH1 is the mean number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

fh5.description: Flood frequency. Compute the average number of flow events with flows above a threshold equal to the median flow value for the entire flow record. FH5 is the mean number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

fh6.description: Flood frequency. Compute the average number of flow events with flows above a threshold equal to three times the median flow value for the entire flow record. FH6 is the mean number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

fh7.description: Flood frequency. Compute the average number of flow events with flows above a threshold equal to seven times the median flow value for the entire flow record. FH7 is the mean number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

fl1.description: Low flood pulse count. Compute the average number of flow events with flows below a threshold equal to the 25th percentile value for the entire flow record. FL1 is the mean number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

fl3.description: Frequency of low pulse spells. Compute the average number of flow events with flows below a threshold equal to 5 percent of the mean flow value for the entire flow record. FL3 is the mean number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

lf1.description: Number of days per year below a threshold of 0.1 cubic feet per second per square mile. LF1 is the median annual number of days below the threshold (number of days/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma12.description: Mean of monthly flow values for January. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma13.description: Mean of monthly flow values for February. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma14.description: Mean of monthly flow values for March. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma15.description: Mean of monthly flow values for April. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma16.description: Mean of monthly flow values for May. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma17.description: Mean of monthly flow values for June. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma18.description: Mean of monthly flow values for July. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma19.description: Mean of monthly flow values for August. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma20.description: Mean of monthly flow values for September. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma21.description: Mean of monthly flow values for October. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma22.description: Mean of monthly flow values for November. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma23.description: Mean of monthly flow values for December. Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma3.description: Coefficient of variation (standard deviation/mean) for each year. Compute the coefficient of variation for each year of daily flows. Compute the mean of the annual coefficients of variation (percent - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma4.description: Standard deviation of the percentiles of the logs of the entire flow record divided by the mean of percentiles of the logs. Compute the log10 of the daily flows for the entire record. Compute the 5th, 10th, 15th, 20th, 25th, 30th, 35th, 40th, 45th, 50th, 55th, 60th, 65th, 70th, 75th, 80th, 85th, 90th, and 95th percentiles for the logs of the entire flow record. Percentiles are computed by interpolating between the ordered (ascending) logs of the flow values. Compute the standard deviation and mean for the percentile values. Divide the standard deviation by the mean (percent - spatial). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ma99.description: Mean annual flow, calculated as the mean of monthly flow variables (ma12-ma23) Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

mh14.description: Median of annual maximum flows. Compute the annual maximum flows from monthly maximum flows. Compute the ratio of annual maximum flow to median annual flow for each year. MH14 is the median of these ratios (dimensionless - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

mh20.description: Specific mean annual maximum flow. MH20 is the mean of the annual maximum flows divided by the drainage area (cubic feet per second/square mile - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ml17.description: Base flow. Compute the mean annual flows. Compute the minimum of a 7-day moving average flow for each year and divide them by the mean annual flow for that year. ML17 is the median of those ratios (dimensionless - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ra1.description: Rise rate. Compute the change in flow for days in which the change is positive for the entire flow record. RA1 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second/day - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ra3.description: Fall rate. Compute the change in flow for days in which the change is negative for the entire flow record. RA3 is the mean of these values (cubic feet per second/day - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

ra8.description: Number of reversals. Compute the number of days in each year when the change in flow from one day to the next changes direction. RA8 is the mean of the yearly values (days - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

spr_dur3.description: Spring (April-June) maximum of 3-day moving average flows. Compute the maximum of a 3-day moving average flow for each year. SPR_DUR3 is the median of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

spr_dur7.description: Spring (April-June) maximum of 7-day moving average flows. Compute the maximum of a 7-day moving average flow for each year. SPR_DUR7 is the median of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

spr_freq.description: Flood frequency for April-June. Compute the average number of flow events with flows above a threshold equal to the 10th percentile for the entire flow record. SPR_FREQ is the median number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

spr_mag.description: Specific mean spring (April-June) maximum flow. MH20 is the median of the annual maximum flows divided by the drainage area (cubic feet per second/square mile - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

spr_ord.description: Julian date of spring (April-June) maximum. Determine the Julian date that the maximum flow occurs for each year. SPR_ORD is the median of these values (Julian day - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

sum_cv.description: Coefficient of variation (standard deviation/mean) for each year for the summer (July-September). Compute the coefficient of variation for each year of daily flows. Compute the median of the annual coefficients of variation (percent - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

sum_dur3.description: Summer (July-September) minimum of 3-day moving average flow. Compute the minimum of a 3-day moving average flow for each year. SUM_DUR3 is the median of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

sum_dur7.description: Summer (July-September) minimum of 7-day moving average flow. Compute the minimum of a 7-day moving average flow for each year. SUM_DUR7 is the median of these values (cubic feet per second - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

sum_freq.description: Flood frequency for July-September. Compute the average number of flow events with flows below a threshold equal to the 90th percentile for the entire flow record. SUM_FREQ is the median number of events (number of events/year - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

sum_mag.description: Minimum of the summer (July-September) flows divided by the drainage area (cubic feet per second/square mile - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

sum_ord.description: Julian date of summer (July-September) minimum. Determine the Julian date that the minimum flow occurs for each water year. SUM_ORD is the median of these values (Julian day - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

th1.description: Julian date of annual maximum. Determine the Julian date that the maximum flow occurs for each year. TH1 is the median of these values (Julian day - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.

tl1.description: Julian date of annual minimum. Determine the Julian date that the minimum flow occurs for each water year. TL1 is the median of these values (Julian day - temporal). Values are derived from applying the GCM-projected changes to the historical Maurer baseline.
